description:
Your garden could be doing more for the planet than you realise. By giving nature more space to do its own thing, we can help boost biodiversity, create healthier ecosystems and improve our own wellbeing too. 

Fixing the Planet is a digital series, sponsored by Speed & Scale, that spotlights the everyday choices and cutting-edge innovations that can help us preserve our planet for generations to come. To find out more visit: https://bbcearth.com/fixing-the-planet
